scope: Eight released Vulcane registrations and bounded Rage/targeting regression evidence. Not an in-game reproduction or a patch to the owner-local candidate.

findings.detail: The success branch passes current Rage to consume, not the configured threshold.

findings.status: released call-argument observation; design/runtime review required
findings.detail: BattleVulcane passes hitEntity as the effect target and user as the source to applyPotions.
Damage and drain handlers write value directly without setValue/addValue/needsSync; incremental resource collection is gated on needsSync. Other runtime paths may cause later synchronization.
A positive value smaller than the per-tick drain can become negative because the selected handler subtracts without the clamping setter.

limits: Damage formula produces an attack input, not guaranteed health loss
Vanilla last-attacker lifetime and final damage acceptance need exact-build testing
EffectBuilder level arguments are recorded without assuming unverified amplifier semantics
Do not assume the private owner-local implementation contains these released upstream paths
